description: User-selected High qualification fixture, 2026-10-01: sp_a1_intro4_relit (the published relit Intro4 map; the workload named sp_a1_intro4_probe64 until 2026-10-07, when the user renamed it to the published map). The camera samples arrival and reverse at the retained profiling position, warms both orientations for 10 seconds before the bracket, measures every frame including turns and returns, and drains delayed GPU timestamps afterward. This is camera/frame performance evidence, not complete story or image parity. The previous laser tour remains available as a script but is not the selected workload. Numeric targets and High settings are owned by render_budget_row and its referenced product profile.
